name: EmptyState
description: Where a list or region has nothing to show: a dashed 1px outline in the emphasis border colour, the card's corner, no fill or shadow, a muted centred message and an optional action under it. The Ringmaster board's empty Your work card.
usage: Use in place of a list, stack or column body that is empty, so the space reads as a place where things will go rather than a gap
Say what is missing in plain words ("No tasks for you right now"); an action only when the person can do something about it here (a small Button, a TextLink)
Give minHeight one card's height when it holds a card's place in a row or stack, so the layout doesn't jump when the first card arrives
Width is the container's; className and style for layout
For content that is loading, not empty, use Skeleton
examples:
// the board's empty Your work: one compact card's height
<EmptyState message="No tasks for you right now" minHeight="9.1875rem" />
design: Outline: 1px dashed --color-border-emphasis (a border style on the existing colour, no token of its own)
No fill, no shadow: the column or page shows through
Text type-body-sm (14px, line height 1.5) in --color-text-muted, centred both ways; icon, message and action stacked --spacing-xs apart
No height of its own beyond its content and padding unless minHeight is given
accessibility: A plain div: its message is read in order, like the list it stands in for

Not a live region by default. One that mounts with its text is announced unreliably, and when it is, it repeats on every mount (each tab switch). Announcing that an action emptied the list is that action's job. Pass role="status" for an empty state whose appearing should be announced
The icon is decorative and aria-hidden; the message carries the meaning
The action stays in the Tab order

props.name: message
props.description: What is (not) here. Or pass children; children win when both are given.

props.name: action
props.description: Something to do about it, under the message: a levain Button or TextLink.

props.name: icon
props.description: A decorative glyph above the message, hidden from screen readers.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: The least height: px when a number, else any CSS length. None by default.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout classes added to the box's own.
